input.quote: The Parties recognize and agree that the PG does not make any representations or warranties, including, but not limited to, any representation or warranty regarding:
input.rationale: This is a consortium construction, ownership and O&M agreement among co-owning carriers, not a vendor supply contract: the performing "vendor" for the Wet Segment is the Supplier under the Supply Contract, which is not a party here. The only warranty language is the disclaimer in Subparagraph 4.9 (p0126–p0127), and that disclaimer runs in favour of the Procurement Group, which under Subparagraph 3.8 (p0101) is composed of representatives of each Initial Party — a list that expressly includes Teleglobe (p0053). Our client therefore sits on the protected side of that disclaimer, so flagging it would work against us. Substantive protection against non-conforming plant is instead procured upstream and passed through: Subparagraph 4.6 requires the Supply Contract to specify the RFPA Date, 4.7 secures examination, test and inspection rights, and 4.8 (p0124–p0125) empowers the PG, acting on behalf of the Parties, to exercise the Supply Contract's rights and remedies where the Wet Segment fails specifications or capacity or the Supplier is in material breach; Paragraph 10 adds continuing "efficient working order" maintenance duties with a self-help remedy if a Maintenance Authority fails to restore. Noted but not flagged: there is no stated conformance period or repair/replace/refund remedy running between the Parties, and the express-warranty carve-out our model language contemplates has no counterparty to bind here.
